limitations: The selected dependency-closed module pass strict compilation and recursive audit.
Recorded compiled-artifact hashes cross-checked between receipts, not independently rehashed against downloaded binaries.
scope: For every prime p, p not dividing B and primitive integer x,z,w satisfying z^2-a*x^2-p*B*w^2 divisible by p^2 imply IsSquare(a : ZMod p). Includes p=2 and p dividing a; no coprimality assumption on a.
Only the modular-root implication is checked, not the Qp-to-primitive bridge, CRT/normalization/induction, or a local-global theorem.
